title: Pathway-based ensemble risk score tied to cisplatin sensitivity in small cell lung cancer
summary: Cisplatin sensitivity and transcriptomes of 39 SCLC cell lines (GDSC2) were scored with ssGSEA across 236 Hallmark and KEGG pathways, yielding an eight-pathway set (Overlap8) negatively correlated with ln(IC50). After prognostic validation in a local cohort (n=45), 144 model combinations were compared and an equal-weight CoxBoost + plsRcox ensemble risk score was frozen, then applied unchanged to two external cohorts (GSE60052 and TU-SCLC) with an external-only meta-analysis. Cohorts are public or retrospective, effect sizes are not visible in the abstract, and the mechanistic analyses are exploratory.
ai_technology: CoxBoost and plsRcox survival-model ensemble on ssGSEA pathway scores

evidence.tested: Frozen risk score applied to a local cohort (n=45) and two independent external cohorts with meta-analysis.
evidence.unknown: Effect sizes, and prospective or clinical utility; full text not reviewed.
